dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: I'm quite tired of fretting about the paperwork needed to open a store. Should I just invite Ms. Ryouko to come to the festival with me?

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: But she's got so many customers right now... Ah, what do I do...

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: *sigh* Friend, could you please take a look at this and tell me what else I have to do to complete my application?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's with your application?

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: I've heard that it's become very troublesome to apply for a visit to Inazuma recently. Therefore, I asked a friend from Snezhnaya to help me.

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: I went through much trouble to get the documents ready and came all the way over here with a fleet...

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: In the end, that inspector named Yurika kept saying that I am still missing some "materials," which need to be added on.

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: But I don't get it. Apart from these documents, what else do I still need?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you... brought your wallet?

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: Huh, my wallet?

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: I do have my wallet with me. But I'm not in the habit of putting documents in my wallet. And I've already brought all the things that they need...

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: *sigh* I've been staying in Ritou for too long. I don't really have any more cash left. If I can't sell my goods in the city, I'll be in trouble...

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: There isn't much I can do with this small amount of money. I might as well go for a drink at Miss Ryouko's stall.

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: Miss Ryouko will be able to console me for sure, bless her kind soul.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry, I can't really help you...

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: *sigh* That's okay. Thank you for your concern anyway... I will figure out a way...

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: Alas, the application still can't be done. It's even more troublesome now...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's with your application?

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: *sigh* Let me tell you my story. I'm so unlucky!

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: Previously, I asked a Snezhnayan friend for help, and prepared all the documents painstakingly. I then came a long way here with the fleet...

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: In the end, I never got the Travel Permit application done because I didn't understand their "handling fee" standard!

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: Now, the Kanjou Commission is undergoing an inspection from the authorities, and is no longer asking for exorbitant fees...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd consider that an improvement.

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: Well, less taxation is always good, sure, but with all these delays, all the documents that I prepared beforehand have expired!

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: They now all need updating, and I was going to look for my Snezhnayan friend for some help there — it's funny, you know? I can't contact him at all...

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: I've been stuck here in Ritou so long, I'm almost out of Mora on hand. Oh, what am I going to do...

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: There isn't much I can do with this small amount of money. I might as well go for a drink at Miss Ryouko's stall.

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: Miss Ryouko will be able to console me for sure, bless her kind soul.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry, I couldn't help you...

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: *sigh* that's okay. Thank you for your concern anyway... I will figure out a way...

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: Let me see. If I want to set up shop here in Ritou, I'll need these... and these...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Opening a store?

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: Aye, yes. As you know, the Sakoku Decree has been abolished.

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: So honestly, I could return to Mondstadt any time. But I just can't do it — I mean, how can I just leave Inazuma without having done any business here?

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: And I've heard the news, you know — about all the people coming here to Ritou, looking to establish their businesses. That really gets my fingers itching, you know? So... What do you think? Should I give this a go?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry to bother you, then.

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: *sigh* That's okay. I'll figure something out...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds like a good idea.

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: I know, right? If I can set up early, I might just hit upon some good opportunities first.

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: But I reckon that my documents are going to need updating first. I was going to ask my Snezhnayan friend for help, actually, but I haven't been able to contact him at all...

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: I've been stuck here in Ritou so long, I'm almost out of Mora on hand. Oh, what am I going to do...

dialogues.speaker: Robert
dialogues.text: You know what? I think I'll just go over to Miss Ryouko's for a drink. She'll be able to console me for sure, bless her kind soul.
